The static Phase 3B path coefficient from order-service to gateway was regularized to 0.2450 by Ridge (predicting 60.77ms). The counterfactual engine correctly uses the topological propagation attenuation (0.62^1), recovering the full 232.50ms avoided latency, while correctly raising a documented warning regarding mediator queueing risk.
